name: Gonk's Blessing and Krag'wa's Blessing modify Amphibimorph natively (#1179, #3693)
contract: Gonk's Blessing 806469 and Krag'wa's Blessing 807855 (SpellFamilyName 19) are passive spell mods on Amphibimorph 500952 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] = 0x80000000), not scripted effects, and no module code or SQL touches any of the three ids (grep of modules/, src/server/, data/sql/ found nothing beyond the mod-spellbook tree listing). 806469 effect 0 is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -60001 + DieSides 1 = -60000ms; effect 1 is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints 499 + DieSides 1 = +500ms. 807855 effect 0 is aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -101 + DieSides 1 = -100%. Both carry EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 0x80000000, matching Amphibimorph's family flags, and AttributesEx3 = 0 (SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS is NOT set), so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-19 fallthrough (SpellInfo.cpp:1552, IsAffected) applies them: Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10218) folds op 11 into 120000 - 60000 = 60000ms and op 10 into (1000+500)*1 = 1500ms for Gonk, and (1000+0)*0 = 0ms for Krag'wa (Player.cpp:10262 only skips a -100% cast-time mod when base >= 10000, so Amphibimorph's 1000ms base is not skipped). This scenario proves both stay wired through the native spell-mod pipeline with no CoA class code involved, and fails if a future change (e.g. adding these ids to DoctorSpells / AscensionWitchDoctor::ApplyContracts, or setting SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS anywhere upstream) breaks that native path.
